baseline_findings.title: Missing access control for '/revoke' route
baseline_findings.description: The '/revoke' route does not have any authentication or authorization checks. This allows any user to revoke another user's token, which could lead to unauthorized access.
baseline_findings.context_reasoning: No authentication check is present in the evidence or shown callers. The '/revoke' route should require authentication to ensure that only authorized users can revoke tokens for other users.
baseline_findings.suggested_fix: Add an authentication check, such as passport.authenticate('jwt', { session: false }), before handling the '/revoke' request.

baseline_findings.title: Missing authentication for /login/2fa-verify endpoint
baseline_findings.description: The /login/2fa-verify endpoint is exposed without any authentication mechanism. This allows unauthenticated users to access the endpoint, which could potentially lead to unauthorized access or manipulation of user data.
baseline_findings.context_reasoning: No authentication check (e.g., passport.authenticate) was found on this function or any shown caller. The operation requires authentication to ensure that only authenticated users can access it.
baseline_findings.suggested_fix: Add an authentication middleware, such as passport.authenticate('jwt', { session: false }), before the route handler to require a valid JWT token for access.

baseline_findings.title: Missing authentication for /2fa/setup route
baseline_findings.description: The /2fa/setup route is a public endpoint that does not require any form of authentication or authorization. This exposes the route to unauthorized access, allowing anyone to perform operations on it.
baseline_findings.context_reasoning: No authentication check (e.g., passport.authenticate) is present in the evidence or shown callers for the /2fa/setup route. This makes the route publicly accessible without any form of authentication, which is a significant security risk.
baseline_findings.suggested_fix: Add an authentication check to ensure that only authenticated users can access this route. For example, use passport.authenticate('jwt', { session: false }) to require JWT-based authentication.
